confirmed_defects.status: CONFIRMED: fresh fixture reproduced in both full matrix runs
confirmed_defects.title: Git disappearing after worktree discovery becomes proof of zero unpushed/unique commits
confirmed_defects.mechanism: A fixture-local PATH exposes a real forwarding git wrapper during command -v and worktree discovery. The wrapper returns real git worktree list output, then unlinks itself. Subsequent git log calls exit 127. Pipelines to wc -l with || true turn their failure into 0; evaluate_worktree consequently bypasses the named-branch-unpushed refusal and emits SAFE(metadata-prune).
confirmed_defects.fresh_ground_truth: The absent registration is on refs/heads/wt-local. /usr/bin/git rev-list --count refs/heads/wt-local --not --remotes returns 1 before and after the attack. Normal PATH returns NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch). No fabricated git output is used.

observed.souji-quarantine.sh: Its real child engine propagates QVERDICT stage1 SAFE metadata-prune, changes baseline DRY-RUN-BLOCKED/exit 3 to SKIPPED/exit 0. No deletion: metadata-prune is skipped before staging.
observed.souji-census.sh: Does not emit clean. Reports no-remote,status-unverifiable. Numeric unpushed falls to 0 but the uncertainty flag prevents treating this as a safe verdict; not counted as another safety defect.

confirmed_defects.contradicted_invariant: An absent named-branch worktree with unpushed commits must be NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch); dependency failure is not a zero-commit receipt.
confirmed_defects.suggested_fix_not_applied: Capture and check each git command's exit status before counting its output. On failure, refuse with an explicit unverifiable reason; initial command -v is not sufficient. Do not convert unknown counts to zero.
evidence_pointers: reproduction.python_lines below: mode=git, including the quarantine propagation

confirmed_defects.status: CONFIRMED: LANG=tr_TR alone, with LC_ALL unset, reproduced in both full matrix runs
confirmed_defects.title: Turkish lowercase conversion bypasses the case-insensitive ID_* path refusal
confirmed_defects.mechanism: is_secret_shaped uses Bash ${comp,,} without fixing LC_CTYPE. Under a real Turkish locale, ASCII I lowercases to U+0131, so ID_SENTINEL becomes ıd_sentınel and no longer matches id_*. The target then obtains a stale receipt.
confirmed_defects.fixture_safety: The target is an EMPTY directory named .scratch/ID_SENTINEL, aged three days. No secret-shaped regular file is created or read. No actual secrets or vault data are used.
confirmed_defects.locale_proof: Host initially has no Turkish locale. localedef --no-archive -i tr_TR -f UTF-8 <fixture>/locale/tr_TR succeeds without privilege changes. With LOCPATH=<fixture>/locale, LANG=tr_TR and all LC_* variables removed, Bash prints LANG=tr_TR LC_ALL=unset lower=ıd_sentınel, with no locale warning.

observed.souji-verify.sh: LC_ALL=C baseline: NOT-SAFE(secrets-refusal). LANG=tr_TR attack: exit 0, SAFE(stale).
observed.souji-vault-verify.sh: LC_ALL=C baseline: NOT-VERIFIED(secrets-refusal). LANG=tr_TR attack: exit 0, SAFE / VERIFIED(stale).
observed.souji-quarantine.sh: Correctly refuses the same empty directory in both locales; it exports LC_ALL=C at line 121. No stage or deletion occurs.
observed.souji-census.sh: Ordinary fixture census is byte-identical between C and Turkish. Empty directories are not in its newest-regular-file scan, so no claim is made about census secret-name folding.

confirmed_defects.contradicted_invariant: Secret-shaped components are refused case-insensitively before receipt evaluation, independent of the user's locale.
confirmed_defects.suggested_fix_not_applied: Use locale-independent ASCII case folding, or fix LC_ALL=C consistently as quarantine already does. Add an actual locally generated Turkish-locale regression, not a LANG assignment that silently falls back to C.

TMPDIR_unwritable.method: Each fixture uses its own mode-0555 TMPDIR. A real mktemp probe fails Permission denied, proving the hostile storage condition without mounting or exhausting a filesystem.
TMPDIR_unwritable.results: verify and vault retain NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch); quarantine exits 1 before any move, with base.txt preserved; census --compare exits 1 without emitting a falsely empty successful diff. Denied temp dirs remain empty.

PATH_sha256sum_disappears_mid_run.method: The git worktree-list shim removes only the fixture-local sha256sum symlink, after startup dependency checks.
PATH_sha256sum_disappears_mid_run.results: verify refuses the valid ledger pair as source-sha-mismatch; vault emits NOT-VERIFIED(source-hash-mismatch). A real quarantine stale flow stages the file, then detects empty digest pins and ABORTS/exit 3, keeping .ufo-quarantine/<date>/.scratch/aged.out. Census remains correctly clean because it does not use SHA-256 for this measurement.
PATH_sha256sum_disappears_mid_run.limitation: Quarantine stages before noticing an absent hash utility. This is not counted as a false DELETE: bytes remain in quarantine and the second check fails.

CWD_deleted_mid_run.method: Launch from an empty fixture cwd; a real forwarding git wrapper rmdir's that cwd on its first call while the parent tool continues running. Test each tool with absolute and relative addressing. Event logs and absent cwd assertions verify deletion actually happened.
CWD_deleted_mid_run.results: Absolute addressing: both verifiers correctly prove the fixture's pushed file, census is correctly clean, and quarantine completes one legitimate pushed deletion with intro-blob=ok. Relative addressing: both verifiers refuse, quarantine returns NOT-AUTHORIZED/exit 3 with the file intact, and census remains correct after early root canonicalization. All eight cases finish without hitting the 5-second timeout.
CWD_deleted_mid_run.important: The valid pushed fixture deletion is NOT a false DELETE and is excluded from the defect count.
